## The problem

Describe the reading or listening problem you want solved. For example:
"Long chapters take too long to start" or "I want to keep the page's own
chapter navigation."

## Proposed solution

What you would like Paradox to do.

## Alternatives considered

Any workarounds or other approaches you have tried.

## Scope check

Paradox reads text that is already visible in the browser, for personal use.
Features that scrape, bypass paywalls, or send reading data off the machine are
out of scope.
